'''Ropedancers''' were [[Water/Legends|water]] serpents found on [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]]. With an average diameter of 1 [[Meter/Legends|meter]] and a maximum length of 48 meters, these fanged predators had a very elastic digestive system and were capable of expanding it up to twice its normal size.<ref name="GG2" />

On rare occasions, Ropedancers were known to have swallowed entire [[Ursod]]s.<ref name="GG2" />
